# Tickets Pro

> Tickets Pro is an intelligent multi-modal travel planning platform for IRCTC train ticket reservations, live Indian domestic/international flight search, intercity bus booking, and automated Tatkal assistance.

## Overview
Tickets Pro provides enterprise-grade travel booking tools, real-time seat availability monitoring across Indian Railways (IRCTC), live flight discovery via Google Flights, interactive deck/berth bus booking, instant Tatkal booking coordination, 10-digit PNR status tracking with live coach/berth confirmation, multi-wallet settlement, and dedicated WhatsApp support.

## Key Capabilities
- **Live Train Seat Availability**: Instant availability checks across SL, 3A, 2A, 1A, 3E, and CC quotas across all IRCTC zones.
- **Flight Search & Booking**: Real-time INR pricing, non-stop filters, and multi-airline flight comparisons across Indian and international routes.
- **Intercity Bus Booking**: Interactive Lower/Upper deck sleeper & seater layouts with boarding/dropping points and WhatsApp e-ticket dispatch.
- **Tatkal Booking Assistance**: Automated workflows ensuring rapid booking submission during 10:00 AM (AC) and 11:00 AM (Non-AC) Tatkal windows.
- **WhatsApp PNR Status**: Instant 10-digit PNR status checks via automated WhatsApp bot and live dashboard lookup.
- **Secure Refund & Cancellation**: Zero-friction automated refund calculation conforming strictly to Indian Railways refund rules.
- **Android App & Web Control Center**: Multi-platform access with offline ticket storage and push notifications.
